learning_outcomes.text: The student will learn principles, mathematical models and methods of analysis, sizing, simulation, control and supervision of automation systems.

The student will be able to understand the general problems and proceed with the management of real-time control methods of automation systems, with attention to their dynamic components that evolve over time and/or based on discrete events.

The student will be able to identify the organizational characteristics of an integrated automation system and its individual components, to analyze its operational complexity, performance and any critical issues.
The course enables the student to present automation problems in industrial and non-industrial plants and processes, with their main solutions.
The course aims to create independent learning attitudes oriented towards the analysis and solution of automation problems.
The student will be able to understand the general problems and proceed with the design and programming of the control methods of an automation system.

At the end of the exam, the student will master the fundamental concepts of computer integrated manufacturing and will be able to design and analyze an industrial automation system from a logical and technological point of view.

syllabus_topics: Real-time control systems and task scheduling
Computer networks and protocols for automation
Field control using analog or digital PID controllers and their tuning
Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and their languages
Modeling, analysis, and control of discrete event systems
Modeling and supervisory control with Petri nets
assessment_rules: The final grade will be 50% from the written exam and 50% from the oral exam if the oral exam is chosen. To pass the exam, a grade not lower than 18/30 is required. To achieve 30/30 cum laude, the student must demonstrate excellent knowledge of all course topics and the ability to connect them logically and coherently.
bibliography: C. Bonivento, L. Gentili, A. Paoli: "Sistemi di automazione industriale: Architetture e controllo", McGraw Hill, 2011.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
